$comment: THE hand-written part. Four packages are generated from this directory and are never edited. Notion publishes a current first-party REST reference but no downloadable machine-readable specification, so the definition stays anchored to its versioned documentation rather than a community OpenAPI file.
title: Notion

oauth.$capabilitiesComment: Notion's authorization URL has no scope parameter. Read content is selected as a connection capability in the Developer portal and appears on the consent prompt; inventing an OAuth scope string would produce a request Notion does not document.
oauth.$refreshTokenRotates: Notion's refresh-token reference says a successful refresh returns both a new access token and a new refresh token. The host must replace the stored pair atomically and must not refresh concurrently or replay the submitted token after an ambiguous failure.
oauth.$accessTokenTtlSeconds: Notion's current create-token and refresh-token response schemas do not expose expires_in or state a fixed access-token lifetime. Null is the considered answer; a numeric schedule would be invented.

$headersComment: Every REST request must carry Notion-Version. 2026-03-11 is the current version in Notion's reference; omitting it opts into an old default and can change page, database and data-source shapes.
$sandboxComment: Notion asks public-connection authors to choose a development workspace. It uses the same api.notion.com host, so the OAuth installation and selected workspace isolate test pages rather than a separate API endpoint.
sandboxNote: Install the public connection into a dedicated Notion development workspace and grant it only test pages. Calls use the live API and create or read real content inside that workspace.

credentialFields.label: OAuth client ID
credentialFields.help: The public connection's OAuth client ID from its Configuration tab.

credentialFields.label: OAuth client secret
credentialFields.help: The matching secret used by the host for code exchange and token refresh.

credentialFields.label: Access token
credentialFields.help: The bearer token for one user's installation in one Notion workspace.

credentialFields.label: Refresh token
credentialFields.help: The rotating refresh token. Replace it atomically with the new value returned by every refresh.
